decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for a new access and 6 parking spaces would preserve and enhance the setting of the listed building and would not have a significant adverse upon adjoining residential occupiers, or affect pedestrian safety subject to the attached conditions.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.5 (Development affecting the setting of a listed building) and T.5.3 (Vehicular Crossovers) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding details shown on drawing 5003 Rev B, details of materials of the pier cappings shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, prior to the commencement of development.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding details shown on drawing 5003 Rev B, details of the brick bonds to the piers, repointing and mortar mix for reconstruction shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstadning details shown on 5003 Rev B, details of materials to be used for the crossover, kerbs and hardstanding shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - A scheme for the re-use of the bricks from the demolition of the listed wall shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Creation of 6 X off street parking spaces and new vehicular access and entrance gates to site.
